scope: Secondary source contrast feasibility only; does not replace Ando, admit training, or create prediction scores
roster: Use every observed pair and all52 phages/25 hosts from previously authenticated roster, before outcome inspection. No favorable subset.
values: Parse finite numeric0/1 exactly using Decimal; abort other states; preserve missing Cartesian pairs as unknown.
contrast: For every unordered host pair, count distinct phages providing each opposite0/1 orientation. Report how many pairs have both orientations and total within-phage positive-negative comparisons.
interpretation: Both orientations imply no single fixed host order can satisfy all comparisons. Their presence is not model evidence; absence alone in a multihost panel does not prove a globally consistent order.
endpoint: Source spot clearance/no clearance, not automatically productive infection or plaque formation
split: No training/evaluation split, source subset, biological score or host genome download in this audit. Genomic groups and target exclusions remain mandatory before any fit.
